name: io.github.FrankXLT/mcp-adv-netutils
title: Advanced Network Utilities
description: Pure-Go L2-L7 network diagnostics, triage recipes, 30-day cron monitor, and Operator Studio.

packageArguments.description: Run mcp-adv-netutils over standard input/output without HTTP listeners or PATH_SECRET.

environmentVariables.name: PASS_HASH
environmentVariables.description: Optional 64-hex SHA-256 deadbolt passphrase hash for 30-minute unlock of sensitive diagnostics and watchlist mutations.

environmentVariables.name: PATH_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional high-entropy path secret protecting the remote HTTP MCP doorway (/{PATH_SECRET}/mcp).

environmentVariables.name: LAN_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional token protecting the RFC1918-only LAN doorway (/lan/{LAN_MCP_TOKEN}/mcp).

environmentVariables.name: NETUTILS_ALLOW_CIDRS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated CIDR allowlist restricting active diagnostic probe targets.

environmentVariables.name: NETUTILS_DENY_CIDRS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated CIDR denylist blocking probe targets (169.254.0.0/16 is always blocked).
